t: The Bahco PrizeCut Toolbox Saw is designed for smooth, precise cutting across a wide range of materials, including aluminium, plastics, laminates, wood and chipboard. Its hardpoint fleam tooth design delivers clean cuts and extended cutting life, while the robust one-piece screwed handle provides a comfortable and secure grip. Compact and easy to carry, the saw fits conveniently into most toolboxes, making it ideal for trade and general-purpose use.
b: Cuts Wood, Laminate, Sheet Metal & Plastic
